# V8V88V8V88

> Personal portfolio and digital garden of Vaibhav (known as V8). A Computer Science student and software developer from India building open-source software, Linux tooling, and developer utilities.

- [Projects](https://v8v88v8v88.com/projects/): Full catalog of open-source projects, themes, system utilities, and CLI tools.
- [Blogs](https://v8v88v8v88.com/blogs/): Technical blog articles covering Linux, minimalism, and system configuration.
- [Contact](https://v8v88v8v88.com/contact/): Contact methods, social links, Telegram, and PGP key.
